[[Shaunur's Scepter]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Shaunur the Divine]], a [[boss]] in [[The City of Torc'qua]].

==Stats==
:[[Fire damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spells]] (Chance: 10%)
:Halves casting time of spells (Chance: 10%)

**[[Deldrimor Scepter]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Fan of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
